conflicts.topic: 自由十字勋章的 1918 / 1940 日期

sources.source: Office of the President of Finland, Symbols / Decorations
sources.statement: The Order of the Cross of Liberty was founded on March 4, 1918.

sources.source: A Guide to the Orders and Decorations of Finland (2025), PDF p.36 / printed p.34
sources.statement: The Senate established the Crosses and Medals of Liberty on 4 March 1918; a permanent Order of the Cross of Liberty was founded by decree on 16 December 1940.

conflicts.assessment: The sources label different institutional events: initial establishment of the decorations in 1918 and the later permanent order in 1940. The date difference is preserved rather than silently collapsed.
conflicts.display_resolution: 显示为“自由十字与自由勋章体系始设 1918-03-04；常设勋团以法令设立 1940-12-16”。

resolved_editorial_decisions.decision: 一等功绩勋章作为自由十字勋团的授饰/variant，归入 FI-CROSS-OF-LIBERTY-ORDER，不另建 family。
resolved_editorial_decisions.basis: 芬兰自由十字勋团官方授饰页把“Medal of Merit First Class”列在该勋团授饰表内。

resolved_editorial_decisions.decision: 白玫瑰勋章设立日期显示 1919-01-28；1919-05-16 另记录为章程确认日，不视为冲突或实物授予日期。
resolved_editorial_decisions.basis: Presidentti 官方页面区分 established 与 rules confirmed；2025 指南同样将章程采用/批准置于 5 月 16 日。
